model: Existing fixed-anchor GRM-LR, N500/500 J10 C4; anchors P01-P08; P09/P10 omnibus df4 family; latent null

seeds.order: ascending, minus then zero per seed

multiplicity: Two conditions x three looks x two directional endpoints: Bonferroni simultaneous CP coverage >=.95. The proposed .05/6 is per two-sided interval, split between tails; six one-sided budgets cannot cover twelve directional claims.
primary: Operational Holm FWER, alpha .05, impact minus; failure=event
secondary: impact zero; BH global-null FDR; paired differences descriptive with MCSE and fixed-look intervals, not sequential superiority claims
control: SCOPED CONTROL (LIBERAL .075) iff failure-as-event CP upper <=.075
inflation: SCOPED INFLATION iff failure-as-non-event CP lower >.05; invalid fits cannot prove inferential Type-I inflation
both_flags: Control relative to .075 and inflation relative to .05 can both hold; report both without claiming nominal control.
stop: Only at fixed looks after complete seed pairs; stop when both conditions classified by either criterion, otherwise continue through1500. At1500 unclassified=INCONCLUSIVE. No near-nominal label.
failure: Record every failed analysis once; operational conservative events include invalid fits. Report valid-only rates and missing-outcome lower/upper sensitivity separately. No retry or replacement seeds.
fitting: Uniform GH101 cold starts, unchanged existing GRM engine/settings; independent GH161 scores/logLik/dense information/finite differences and bounds/anchors/LR gates. Only the required omnibus hypotheses, not unrequested component tests.
reuse: No historical fits reused: Stage A numpy2.5.3 scipy1.18.1 pandas3.0.5 differs from available numpy2.4.6 scipy1.17.1 pandas3.1.0. Old results immutable. Regenerate original responses with matching archived data and RNG-draw hashes; never rerun ordinal LR.
technical_stop: Data/source/hash mismatch or memory limit stops immediately; deadline stops with all completed/partial evidence preserved; no inference before a registered look.
prior_outcomes_known: 30 historical pairs are known, not pooled. Fixed future looks/limits are not selected by their events. No general method certification; no production p-value or scientific-label changes from this experiment.
